senses.gloss: अनु 1. अनु, उस्, वी, उ. See अणु.

अनु 2. अनु, उस्, m., Ved. man; N. of a
king, one of Yayāti's sons; (possibly) N. of a non-
Āryan tribe.

अनु 3. अनु, ind. as a prefix to verbs and
nouns, expresses after, along, alongside, lengthwise,
near to, under, subordinate to, with.
(When prefixed to nouns, especially in adverbial
compounds) it implies repetition, according to, seve-
rally, each by each, orderly, methodically.
(As a separable preposition, with accusative) after,
along, over, near to, through, to, towards, at, according
to, in order, agreeably to, in regard to.
(As a separable adverb) after, afterwards, thereupon,
again, further, then, next.

आनु आ-नु, cl. 2. P. -नौति, -नवितुम् or
-नुवितुम्, Ved. 1. A. -नवते, to sound, scream,
warble: Intens. Ved. -नवीनोति, to sound through.

अनुक अनु-क, अस्, आ, अम्, lustful (fr. अनु-
कम्, q. v.; or, according to others, fr. 3. अनु with
affix क).
अनु-क, अस्, आ, अम्, libidinous; see s. v. above.

अनूक अनूक, अस्, अम्, m. n. (fr. अञ्च् with
अनु), the backbone, spine; the back part of the
altar; a former state of existence; (अम्), n. race,
family; peculiarity of race, disposition, character; (आ),
f., N. of an Apsaras.

अनुकथ् अनु-कथ्, cl. 10. P. -कथयति,
-यितुम्, to relate after (some one else); to repeat
(what has been heard).

अनु-कथन, अम्, n. orderly narration, dis-
course, conversation.
अनु-कथित, अस्, आ, अम्, related, repeated.

अनुकनीयस् अनु-कनीयस्, आन्, असी, अस्, the
next youngest.

अनुकम् अनु-कम्, Caus. P. -कामयति,
-यितुम्, to desire.

आनूकम् आनूकम्, ind. (fr. आ-अनूकम् ?), Ved.
in abundance.

अनु-काम, अस्, m., Ved. desire; (अस्, आ, अम्),
according to one's desire, agreeable; (अम्), ind. as
desired, at pleasure; wish after wish (?), after one's
wish (?).
—अनुकाम-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. fulfilling one's
desire.
अनुकामीन, अस्, m. one who acts as he pleases.

अनुकम्प् अनु-कम्प्, cl. 1. A. -कम्पते,
-पितुम्, to sympathize with, compassionate; Caus.
-कम्पयति, -यितुम्, = the same.

अनु-कम्पन, अम्, n. or अनु-कम्पा, f. sym-
pathy, compassion.
अनु-कम्पायिन्, ई, इनी, इ, condoling.

अनु-कम्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, compassionate.
—अनु-
कम्पितात्मन् (˚त-आत्˚), आ, आ, अ, having a compas-
sionate spirit.

अनु-कम्पिन्, ई, इनी, इ, sympathizing with, com-
passionating.

अनु-कम्प्य or अनु-कम्पनीय, अस्, आ, अम्,
pitiable, worthy of sympathy; (अस्), m. an ascetic; a
courier.
अनुकर्ष अनु-कर्ष. See under अनु-कृष्.

अनु-कर्ष, अस्, m. or अनु-कर्षण, अम्, n.
attraction, drawing; invoking, summoning by incan-
tation; the bottom or the axle-tree of a carriage;
grammatical attraction; including a subsequent in a
preceding rule; lagging behind in a ceremony; de-
layed performance of a duty.
अनुकल्प अनु-कल्प. See under अनुकॢप्।

अनु-कल्प, अस्, m. permission to adopt an alter-
native or substitute, as “instead of Kuśa grass you
may use Dūrbā.”

अनुकाङ्क्ष् अनु-काङ्क्ष्, cl. 1. P. A. -काङ्-
क्षति, -ते, -क्षितुम्, to long for, desire, seek.
अनु-काङ्क्षा, f. desire after.
अनु-काङ्क्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, longing for.

अनुकाल अनु-काल, अस्, आ, अम्, opportune,
occasional; (अम्), ind. opportunely, occasionally, on a
proper occasion.
अनुकीर्तन अनु-कीर्तन. See अनु-कॄत्.

अनु-कीर्तन, अम्, n. act of proclaiming or pub-
lishing.

अनुकुञ्चित अनु-कुञ्चित, अस्, आ, अम्, bent,
made crooked.

अनुकुष् अनु-कुष्, cl. 9. P. -कुष्णाति,
-कोषितुम्, to pull or drag along (to lift ?).

अनुकूज् अनु-कूज्, cl. 1. P. -कूजति, -जितुम्,
to follow in cooing or singing or groaning.

अनुकूल अनु-कूल, अस्, आ, अम्, following the
bank (कूल), slope or declivity, according to the current,
favourable, agreeable; conformable to; friendly, kind,
well-disposed; (अस्), m. a faithful or kind and obliging
husband; (आ), f. Croton Polyandrum; N. of a metre;
(अम्), n. favour, kindness (often in an ironical sense).
—अनुकूल-ता, f. concord, good-will, favour, con-
formity, consent; prosperity.
—अनुकूल-नायक, अस्,
m. a kind husband or lover.
—अनुकूल-वायु, उस्,
m. a favourable wind.

अनुकूलय, nom. P. अनुकूलयति, -यितुम्, to
act in a friendly way.

अनुकृ अनु-कृ, cl. 8. P. or poet. A. -करोति,
-कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to do afterwards, to follow in do-
ing, imitate, equal, requite, adopt: Caus. -कारयति,
-यितुम्, to cause one to imitate.

अनुकॄ अनु-कॄ, cl. 6. P. -किरति, -करितुम्,
रीतुम्, to scatter along, to crowd: Pass. -कीर्यते,
to become crowded or filled.

अनु-कर, अस्, आ, अम्, imitating; (अस्), m. an
assistant.
अनु-कार, अस्, m. imitation, resemblance.

अनु-करण, अम्, n. imitation, following an ex-
ample; resemblance, similarity.

अनु-कर्तृ, ता, त्री, तृ, an imitator, imitating;
(ता), m. a mimic, actor, performer.

अनु-कर्मन्, अ, n. imitation; a subsequent rite
or ceremony.

अनु-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, imitating, an imitator, acting,
mimicking^1.

अनु-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, copied, imitated, made or
done like.
अनु-कृति, इस्, f. imitation, a copy, compliance.

अनु-कृत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit to be imitated or
represented.

अनु-क्रिया, f. imitation, doing anything subse-
quently or in like manner; a subsequent rite.
अनु-क्री, f. a subsequent rite or ceremony.

अनुकृत् अनु-कृत्, cl. 6. P. -कृन्तति, -कर्ति-
तुम्, to go on shattering or destroying.

अनुकॄत् अनु-कॄत्, cl. 10. P. -कीर्तयति,
-यितुम्, to relate after (or in order), to narrate.

अनुकृप् अनु-कृप्, cl. 6. A., Ved. -कृपते,
to mourn; nom. A. -कृपायते, -यितुम्, to com-
passionate, condole with.

अनुकृष् अनु-कृष्, cl. 1. P. -कर्षति,
-कर्ष्टुम् or -क्रष्टुम्, to drag after one's self,
attract: Caus. -कर्षयति, -यितुम्, = the same; to
subject.
अनु-कर्षन्, आ, m. the bottom of a carriage.

अनु-कृष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, attracted; included or
implied in a subsequent rule.
आनुकृष्ट आनुकृष्ट = अनु-कृष्ट, q. v.
अनु-कीर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, crowded.

अनुकॢप् अनु-कॢप्, cl. 1. A. -कल्पते,
-कल्पितुम्, -कल्प्तुम्, to follow duly: Caus. -कल्प-
यति, -यितुम्, to get (others) to follow or imitate
duly.
अनु-कल्पित, अस्, आ, अम्, followed, attended.

अनुक्त अन्-उक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, (rt. वच्), un-
uttered, unsaid, unheard of, extraordinary.
—अनुक्त-
निर्मित्त, अम्, n. a reason which is unuttered or un-
heard of or extraordinary; (अस्, आ, अम्,), having such
a reason.
अनूक्त, &c. See s. v., p. 42.
अन्-उक्ति, इस्, f. the not speaking, improper speech.

अनूक्ति, इस्, f. mentioning after, repeated mention,
repetition by way of explanation; study of the Veda.
—अनूक्ति-त्व, अम्, n. state of requiring repetition
or explanation.

अनुक्थ अन्-उक्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. hymn-
less, not singing hymns.

अनुक्रकच अनु-क्रकच, अस्, आ, अम्, serrated,
dentated like a saw.

अनुक्रन्द् अनु-क्रन्द्, cl. 1. A. -क्रन्दते,
-दितुम्, to shout or cry after one.

अनुक्रम् अनु-क्रम्, cl. 1. P. -क्रामति,
-क्रमितुम्, to go on, go after, follow; to go through
in order, enumerate, supply with an abstract or index.

अनु-क्रम, अस्, m. succession, arrangement, order,
method; an index showing the successive contents
of a book; (अम्), ind. in due order.

अनु-क्रमण, अम्, n. proceeding methodically or
in order; following.

अनु-क्रमणिका or अनु-क्रमणी, f. a table or
chapter of contents, especially of the collection of
hymns &c. in Vedic books.

अनु-क्रान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, gone over, read, or done
in due order.

अनु-क्रान्त; add — mentioned or written down
in the Anukramaṇī.

अनुक्रीड् अनु-क्रीड्, cl. 1. A. -क्रीडते, -डितुम्,
to play.

अनुक्रुश् अनु-क्रुश्, cl. 1. P. -क्रोशति,
-क्रोष्टुम्, to shout at: Caus. -क्रोशयति, -यितुम्,
to join in lamenting, show sympathy.
अनु-क्रोश, अस्, m. tenderness, compassion.

अनुक्षणम् अनु-क्षणम्, ind. momentarily,
perpetually, every instant.

अनुक्षत्तृ अनु-क्षत्तृ, ता, m. the door-
keeper's or charioteer's mate or attendant.

अनुक्षपम् अनु-क्षपम्, ind. night after
night.

अनुक्षर् अनु-क्षर्, cl. 1. P. -क्षरति,
-रितुम्, to flow into or upon.

अनुक्षि अनु-क्षि, cl. 6. P., Ved. -क्षियति,
-क्षेतुम्, to overspread, reach: Pass. -क्षीयते, to
decay or vanish gradually.

अनुक्षेत्र अनु-क्षेत्र, अम्, n. stipend (in
commutation probably of the proceeds of an endow-
ment) given to temple-servants in Orissa.

अनुखञ्ज, अनु-खञ्ज, अस्, m., N. of a
country.

अनुख्या अनु-ख्या, cl. 2. P., Ved. -ख्याति,
-तुम्, to descry.

अनु-ख्याति, इस्, f. act of descrying or revealing or
reporting.

अनु-ख्यातृ, ता, m. a discoverer, revealer, re-
porter.

अनुगङ्गम् अनु-गङ्गम्, ind. along the
Ganges.

अनुगण् अनु-गण्, cl. 10. P. -गणयति,
-यितुम्, to count over.
अनु-गणित, अस्, आ, अम्, counted over.
अनु-गणितिन्, ई, इनी, इ, one who has counted over.

अनुगम् अनु-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्-
तुम्, to go after, follow, seek, approach, visit, arrive;
to practise, observe, obey, imitate; to enter into; to
die out, be extinguished: Caus. -गमयति, -यितुम्,
to imitate, cause to die out.

अनु-ग, अस्, आ, अम्, going after, following, cor-
responding with, adapted to; a companion; a follower,
a servant; (at the close of compounds) having fol-
lowers, as बलानुग, having a force following him,
i. e. leader of a force or army; (आ), f., N. of an
Apsaras.

अनुगा अनु-गा, cl. 3. P. -जिगाति, -गातुम्, to
go after, follow, seek, be guided by.

अनु-गत, अस्, आ, अम्, followed (lit. or fig.), as by
a dependant; covered (as by a dress hanging behind);
following; a follower; acquired; extinguished; tally-
ing with; (अम्), n. moderate time in music.
—अनु-
गतार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, having a corresponding
(easily discoverable) meaning.
अनु-गतिक, अस्, m. a follower, an imitator.
आनुगतिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a follower.

अनु-गन्तव्य or अनु-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, proper
to be followed (especially in death); worthy of being
imitated.

अनु-गम, अस्, m. or अनु-गमन, अम्, n. fol-
lowing, going after in life or death; postcremation of
a widow; imitating, approaching.

अनु-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be followed or imi-
tated.

अनु-गामिन्, ई, इनी, इ, following, a follower, a
companion.

अनु-गामुक, अस्, आ, अम्, habitually or constantly
following or attending.

अनुगर्ज् अनु-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. अनु-गर्जति,
-जितुम्, to shout or roar after.
अनु-गर्जित, अम्, n. roaring echo.

अनुगवम् अनु-गवम्, ind. so as to suit the
oxen.
अनुगवीन अनु-गवीन, अस्, m. a cowherd.

अनुगादिन् अनु-गादिन्, ई, इनी, इ, following
in speaking, echoing.

अनुगाह् अनु-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्,
गाढुम्, to plunge after, be immersed in.
अनु-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged, immersed.

अनुगिरम् अनु-गिरम्, ind. on the moun-
tain.

अनुगु अनु-गु, ind. behind the oxen or
cows.

अनुगुप् अनु-गुप्, cl. 1. P. -गोपायति, -गोप्-
तुम्, to protect.

अनु-गुप्त, अस्, आ, अम्, protected, sheltered, con-
cealed.

अनुगृध् अनु-गृध्, cl. 4. P. -गृध्यति,
-गर्धितुम्, to be greedy after.

अनुगॄ अनु-गॄ, cl. 9. P. -गृणाति, -गरितुम्,
रीतुम्, Ved. to join in praising; to rejoin, answer,
repeat.

अनुगै अनु-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to
sing after or to (a person or a tune); to celebrate in
song: Caus. -गापयति, -यितुम्, to make one sing
after or to.

अनु-गीति, इस्, f., N. of a metre of two verses, the
first containing twenty-seven, the second thirty-two
mātrās.

अनुग्र अन्-उग्र, अस्, आ, अम्, not harsh or
violent, mild, gentle.

अनुग्रह् अनु-ग्रह्, cl. 9. P. -गृह्णाति or Ved.
-गृभ्णाति, or cl. 9. A. -गृह्णीते, -ग्रहीतुम्, to
follow in taking or plundering; to support; uphold;
to receive, welcome; treat with kindness, favour,
oblige; foster.
अनु-गृहीत, अस्, आ, अम्, favoured, obliged.

अनु-ग्रह, अस्, m. or अनु-ग्रहण, अम्, n.
favour, kindness, showing favour, conferring benefits,
promoting or furthering a good object; assistance;
facilitating by incantation; rear-guard; (in the Purā-
ṇas) N. of the eighth or fifth creation.
—अनुग्रह-
कातर, अस्, आ, अम्, anxious to please or for favour.
—अनुग्रह-सर्ग, अस्, m. (in Sāṅkhya phil.) crea-
tion of the feelings or mental conditions.
अनु-ग्रहिन्, ई, m., Ved. proficient in magic skill.
अनु-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, gracious, favourable.

अनु-ग्राहक, अस्, इका, अम्, favouring, furthering,
facilitating; favourable, kind, gracious.

अनु-ग्राहित or अनु-ग्रहित (?), अस्, आ, अम्,
favoured.

अनु-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, fit or deserving to be
favoured or furthered.
अनु-जिघृक्षा, f. desire to show favour or kindness.

अनुजिघृक्षा अनु-जिघृक्षा. See under
अनु-ग्रह्.

अनुग्रामम् अनु-ग्रामम्, ind. village after
village.

अनुग्रासक अनु-ग्रासक, अस्, m. a mouthful
(of boiled rice), the equivalent of a mouthful.

अनुघट्ट् अनु-घट्ट्, cl. 10. P. -घट्टयति,
-यितुम्, to stroke, rub lengthwise.

अनुघुष् अनु-घुष्, cl. 1. P., Ved. -घोषति,
-षितुम्, to name aloud.

अनुचक्ष् अनु-चक्ष् cl. 2. A., Ved. -चष्टे,
-चष्टुम्, to look at or up to.

अनुचर् अनु-चर्, cl. 1. P. -चरति, -रितुम्,
to walk or move after or along, to follow, pursue,
traverse, seek after; to follow out, adhere to, attend,
to behave: Caus. -चारयति, -यितुम्, to let or cause
to traverse.

अनु-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, following, attending; (अस्),
m. companion, follower, servant; (आ or ई), f. a female
attendant.

अनुच्चार अन्-उच्चार, non-pronunciation,
skipping words. See उच्-चर्.

अनु-चारक, अस्, m. a follower, attendant; (आ), f.
a female follower or attendant.
अनु-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, following, attending.

अनुचर्चि अनु-चर्चि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. reciting
or repeating (in a chorus).

अनुचि 1. अनु-चि, cl. 5. P. -चिनोति, -चेतुम्,
to set or place along or in regular order.

अनुचि 2. अनु-चि, cl. 3. P., Ved. -चिकेति, to
remember.

1. अनु-चित, अस्, आ, अम्, set or placed along or
lengthwise or in rows.

अनुचित 2. अन्-उचित, अस्, आ, अम्, improper,
wrong, unusual, strange.
—अनुचितार्थ (˚त-अर्˚), अस्,
m. an unusual meaning.

अनुचिन्त् अनु-चिन्त्, cl. 10. P. -चिन्तयति,
-यितुम्, to meditate, consider, recal to mind: Caus.
to make to consider.

अनु-चिन्ता, f. or अनु-चिन्तन, अम्, n. thinking
of, meditating upon, recalling, recollecting; anxiety.

अनु-चिन्तित, अस्, आ, अम्, recollected, recalled,
thought of.

अनुच्च अन्-उच्च, अस्, आ, अम्, not high, low,
humble.
अन्-उच्चैस्, ind. not aloud, in a low voice.

अनुच्छाद अनु-च्छाद, अस्, m. (fr. rt. छद्
with अनु), a garment which hangs down, or probably
[]
